name: Band Shoulder Internal Rotation at 90 Degrees
steps: Anchor a resistance band at shoulder height behind you.
Stand facing away from the anchor with your target upper arm raised to shoulder height and elbow bent at 90 degrees, holding the band with forearm vertical.
Rotate your forearm forward and downward until your forearm is parallel to the floor.
Pause for one count at the bottom of the internal rotation.
Slowly rotate your forearm back up to the vertical starting position under control.
coaching_cues: Keep your upper arm level with your shoulder throughout the rotation.
Do not allow your shoulder to roll forward out of its socket at the bottom of the pull.

sources.attribution: Cornell Health Shoulder Band Strengthening Protocol
